open_points.subject: operation_element_conclusion and reach_operation_element
open_points.text: after not_applied its send needs a fresh approval (find_send_authority), which reach_operation_element requests (decision 32).
open_points.other_text: When find_send_authority returns None MUST, unless an approval of the element with status requested already exists, write one RequestApprovalChange for the element with the binding_id, input_digests, the prepared request_digest and an ApprovalPreview of the operation's service_id, operation_name and effect_class, the prepared request description and the element's input PortRefs; input_digests are the digests of every input value and file in input port name order, list elements in list order. Nothing is sent and the element waits with reason owner_approval for that approval, the existing requested one when there was one, even if its request_digest differs.
open_points.question: Must reach_operation_element always create a fresh approval after a not_applied resolution, or must it reuse any existing requested approval as currently specified?
